root_cause: The dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler treats Escape as a dropdown command even when the dropdown menu is closed, preventing the Escape key from reaching the modal dialog. This causes the modal to not close when pressing Escape on the dropdown toggle button while the menu is closed.
repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to only treat Escape as a dropdown command when the dropdown menu is open (i.e., when the toggle button has the 'show' class). For ArrowUp/ArrowDown, keep the existing behavior (they can open the menu). This allows Escape to propagate to the modal when the dropdown is closed, while still closing the dropdown when open.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now close the modal dialog with Escape when focus is on the dropdown toggle button and the dropdown menu is closed. When the dropdown menu is open, Escape closes only the dropdown menu, preserving the modal. This aligns with WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Dropdown menu may not close with Escape if the toggle button does not have the 'show' class due to a timing issue.
Modal may not close if another component stops propagation.
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey: open modal, focus access toggle, press Escape -> modal should close (access-toggle becomes invisible).
Run regression guard: open modal, open dropdown menu, press Escape -> dropdown should close but modal remains open (access-toggle visible, shared-with unchanged).
